messages:
Aisha: Quick scheduling ask — candidate Jordan Lee for SWE IC3. Looking to schedule onsite loop next week (Wed/Thu). Jordan's timezone: PST. They can do: Wed 10-1pm PST, Thu 9-11am PST. Need system design, backend, frontend, hiring mgr. Can folks drop availability or conflicts? Also note: candidate requested a vegetarian lunch option and will need travel reimbursement form.
Tom: I can do Wed 10:30-11:30 or Thu 9-10. Prefer design slot.
Carlos: Wed conflicts for me. Thu 9:30-10:15 works for frontend.
Maya: I can do Wed 11-12 (backend).
Aisha: Great — tentative plan: Wed loop starting 10:30 PST: 10:30 design (Tom), 11:15 backend (Maya), 12:00 lunch (veg), 12:30 frontend (Carlos) — Carlos said Thu though, hold on.
Carlos: Sorry I misread earlier. I only have Thu 9:30-10:15. If frontend must be Thu, we could split across days but that's awkward for candidate.
Priya: If candidate prefers single-day loop we should prioritize Thu. Hiring mgr availability? @Tom ? Also please confirm travel reimbursement: we use the expense form here: https://redwood-internal/expenses/form (candidate-select).
Tom: I can swap to Thu morning. Thu 9-11 is fine for me (design + HM).
Aisha: OK switching to Thu. Proposed Thu loop: 9:00-9:45 design (Tom), 9:50-10:20 frontend (Carlos), 10:30-11:00 backend (Maya), 11:10-11:40 HM chat (Tom). Candidate confirm?
calendly-bot: Calendly link sent to Jordan (https://calendly.com/redwood/jordan-onsite). Waiting for confirmation.
Aisha: Jordan replied, confirmed Thu 9am slot. They've completed NDA form.
Priya: I'll book conference room Birch-3 for 8:50-12:00 and reserve a quiet Zoom backup in case of remote. Also catering — veg boxed lunch. Anyone need any accommodations?
Carlos: None for me. Thanks for the room.
Maya: All good. Can folks please use the internal feedback form within 24h after loop: https://redwood-internal/hiring/feedback (use candidate code JLEE-2026).
Aisha: Travel reimbursement: Jordan will submit receipts, I'll route to finance. Priya, pls confirm candidate parking instructions and a contact at reception.
Priya: Reception will need the candidate name and ETA — I'll send visitor pass and parking code. Contact is Receptionist Sara (x4321). I'll DM Jordan with directions and ask about any accessibility needs.
Tom: Reminder to reviewers: no salary discussion in loop. Keep interviews focused on scope/impact/skills.
Aisha: Thanks team — sending calendar invites now and will post final confirmed schedule here once invites accepted. :thumbsup:
calendly-bot: Jordan accepted calendar invite. Calendar invites created for reviewers.
Aisha: Final note — parking instructions and lunch preference DM sent to candidate. If anything changes tag me here.
Tom: Thanks, looking forward to it.
Maya: See you Thu.
Carlos: See you Thu.
